reasons: Panel decision 1 was applied in a way that contradicts the rest of the spec and plan, so the build cannot meet all of them. R6 (spec.md lines 26-29) and plan step 6 and step 7 require the load_klines docstring and the app/data/__init__.py module docstring to carry a deprecation note that names `BinanceBanError`. R8 (spec.md line 32) still says 'No CLI message, help text or docstring names Binance or Vision', and plan step 10 still says to 'grep app/ and scripts/ for `binance`, `vision`, `um"` (case-insensitive) and clean what remains', and that grep matches the note. A build that follows the plan in order writes the note in steps 6-7 and then removes it in step 10, which undoes the panel's decision. A build that keeps the note breaks R8, and the build-phase review will flag that against the spec. The fix is a one-line text change at design time: make R8 except the R6 deprecation note (the intent's own wording is narrower, 'CLI messages stop naming Binance or Vision', intent.md line 27), and give step 10's grep the same exception. Today's code has no such note to rely on (app/data/__init__.py line 1 and loader.py line 78), so nothing settles it outside the spec.
classification_reasons: Spec tightness: the acceptance criteria are measurable and every flagged concern is closed (two by the panel, one [x]). The remaining defect is a contradiction between R6 and R8/step 10, not an open concern.

Blast radius: every module of app/data/ is rewritten or deleted (vision.py). The public frame contract changes (three columns removed), as do the public exception set (BinanceBanError), the markets (um becomes futures), the intervals (1s removed), the cache subtree and the meaning of completeness (quiet intervals are no longer gaps). scripts/measure_storage.py changes too, and the external dependency moves to two new hosts. No risk-list item is touched (hits: {}).

Test coverage: the existing tests and the stub are deleted and rewritten (a ratchet is declared), so the existing suite does not cover the new code. About 45 new tests are all still to be written in step 9.
attempted: Intent: checked each intent bullet against the spec. KuCoin REST only (R1), vision.py and the thread pool removed (R2), public names kept and BinanceBanError removed (R6), the CLI kept (R7), the version kept (R9), spot/futures with USDTM only and no mapping (R10-R11), the interval set with 6h refused on futures (R12), the eight columns with close_time and turnover (R14-R16), futures volume documented (R17), completeness semantics (R19-R20), the kucoin/ subtree with binance-vision/ untouched (R22), the rate-limit headers (R5) and the four open questions all answered as the owner said. Nothing nearby is solved in place of the stated problem.

Spec and plan: every requirement maps to a plan step and a Proof test. The panel ledger's three decisions are reflected in R4/step 3 (429 waits gw-ratelimit-reset, capped at 60 s; test_429_without_retry_after_waits_for_the_reset), R6/steps 6-7 (deprecation note) and R22/steps 4 and 6 (DownloadError caught in fetch_range, covered days settled and cached, then re-raised; test_days_fetched_before_a_download_error_stay_cached). The only applied text that is wrong is decision 1's: it conflicts with R8 and step 10 (the park reason). Nit: the refusal text differs between spec ('KuCoin refused (code <c>): <msg>' / '(HTTP <n>): <msg>') and plan step 4 ('KuCoin refused (HTTP <n>, code <c>): <msg>'). The build should pick one.

Claims against today's code: checked against the working tree, which still holds the merge base's code. loader.py: sync_days docstring promise (lines 93-97), _rest_pass, _consecutive_ranges, _on_grid, _worth_caching, _gap_reason, MISSING_IN_FILE/MISSING_IN_REST, _vision_pass/_Cancelled/VISION_WORKERS all exist as the plan says. http.py: BinanceBanError, the 418 branch, WEIGHT_HEADER/WEIGHT_THRESHOLD/WeightPacer, UNKNOWN_WEIGHT_WAIT=1.0, _int_or_none, RETRY_DELAYS=(1,2,4), MAX_RETRY_AFTER=60 (so a reset capped at 60 never triggers the '>' long-wait stop), and the sleep(max(backoff+jitter, retry_after)) shape. rest.py: pacer_for, RestRange(frame, failure). schema.py: frame_from_csv, frame_from_rest, CSV_FIELDS, INT_COLUMNS, MICROSECOND_THRESHOLD, _to_milliseconds, _is_number, csv/io imports. TIME_COLUMNS is kept, and scripts/measure_storage.py still needs it. params.py: MARKETS, SPOT_ONLY_INTERVALS, validate_symbol(symbol) with one argument (the plan changes it to two, and make_request, cache.py and measure_storage.py are named as callers). cache.py: SUBTREE='binance-vision', file_name imported from vision.py, _DAY_FILE with [smhd] and a symbol without a hyphen, the symbol==directory check, cache_info validating its interval against 'spot'. __main__.py: SOURCE_LABELS, the 'missing inside a file' lines through MISSING_IN_FILE/MISSING_IN_REST, the total line. __init__.py exports BinanceBanError. CLAUDE.md lines 5-6, 30 and 36-37 are the lines the plan names for the owner. No other module imports app.data. pyproject.toml only lists packages. docs/decisions/index.md does not exist. No contradiction found apart from the R6/R8 one.

Measured endpoint rules: checked against references/capture/summary.json. Spot startAt is inclusive (the 1day probe returns the row at startAt) and endAt exclusive. Spot rows are newest first, open/close/high/low, times in seconds, 1500 rows per call keeping the newest. Futures rows are oldest first, open/high/low/close, times in ms, from inclusive, to inclusive (row_at_window_end true), 200 rows per call keeping the oldest. Granularity 360 is refused and 480, 720 and 1440 are accepted. All spot types are accepted. Unknown symbols: spot 400100 'Unsupported trading pair.', futures 200000 with an empty list. A seconds-valued from gets HTTP 400, code 300000. The gw-ratelimit-* headers appear on both hosts. The plan's tables, window rules (spot window_end = oldest; futures window_start = newest + interval, to = end - 1, rows at or after end dropped) and fixtures match.

Paging and completeness: walked spot-backwards and futures-forwards through quiet stretches, a quiet whole day mid-range, a full page that ends mid-day, a failure on page 2, a DownloadError on page 2, an unknown futures symbol and a date before the first candle. In each case the covered span is conservative (a partly covered day is MISSING, never cached), no duplicate rows arise, and every iteration strictly moves the window, so the loop ends. BEFORE_FIRST, NO_CANDLES_ON_DAY and NO_CANDLES are assigned as the spec says. Unmeasured, not a park: on the current day the futures loop asks one more window with from in the future (newest + interval > now). If KuCoin refuses that rather than returning an empty list, today becomes a gap. Capping the range end at now on the current day would remove the dependency. The owner's deploy-gate downloads (2026-10-01..03) do not exercise it. The same applies to a very long futures window (a year at 1m), which was measured only up to 3 days. Either failure raises KlineGapError with KuCoin's message and is never silent.

Proof: design phase, so there are no toolchain logs. The Proof list names a test for each acceptance bullet of the intent and spec: high/low on every fixture row, >1500 spot and >200 futures, the end-of-window row, the 00:14/02:15 fixture, empty/refused/cut-short pages not cached, a 200 with a KuCoin error code, the four refused inputs with no fetch, the second load with no fetch, Parquet only under kucoin/, no Binance host, and the CLI. The fixtures are byte copies of the captured bodies.

Blast radius: the diff touches only changes/0003-.../ (spec, plan, status, evidence). No guardrail file is touched and no risk-list item is hit. Callers of load_klines, cache_info/clear_cache and BinanceBanError, plus scripts/measure_storage.py, are listed in the plan's Risks. Old cache files are never read (new subtree, and read_day checks the schema). There is no new dependency, and pyproject.toml and the CI workflow stay unchanged, which is consistent with CLAUDE.md's 'Things Claude gets wrong' line. The CLAUDE.md edits are handed to the owner.

Policies: security-baseline is applied (envelope, row shape, finite numbers, body bound, urlencode from validated values with fixed hosts, msg stripped of control characters and cut to 200, path containment with no '.' or '/' in a symbol, offline tests). The checksum loss is accepted by the owner in the intent. data-conventions rule 4 is handled by panel decision 1, with the version half left to the owner at the merge. coding-standards (no dead code, one module per job, frozen dataclasses), ux-and-brand (one-line errors, exit 2, copy in constants) and definition-of-done (ratchet declared) are applied, not skipped.

Tests: the tests are planned to run against a stub that enforces the measured window, order and page-cap rules, so a wrong window rule would fail them. The ratchet line names every deleted file and the Binance-only test groups. Behaviours that stay (retries, Retry-After, pacing, gaps, cache layout, atomic write, no-cache mode, current day, redirects, https only, datetime bounds, the CLI exit codes) each keep a named test. The change type is feature, so rewriting tests is allowed.
Skip markers: not applicable at design (the ratchets check runs at build and test). The plan declares none.
Drive: not applicable at design, and commands.drive is empty.
